item.title: Payrolls Triple the Forecast, the Chips Bounce, and Mississippi Widens
item.description: The midday file for November 6, 2026: October payrolls at 165,000 against a 59,000 consensus and unemployment at 4.1 percent, the Nasdaq bouncing an hour into the session, Europe down at its midday, Brent seesawing under $100, Mississippi's margin wider at 2,087, Colorado's 4th at 3,069, the Kremlin answering the president's big agreement with no details, and two more tankers claimed in the strait. Collected at 1200.

item.title: Tokyo Closes in a Bear Market, Brent Crosses a Hundred, and the Count Waits
item.description: The overnight file for November 6, 2026: Tokyo closes 6 percent lower in a bear market and Seoul closes 6 percent lower after a circuit breaker, Brent briefly crosses $100 on the tanker file, the president says he will soon decide on Iran, gold falls with the shares, and no race is called in the night. Collected at 0400.
